answer: Every new agent arrives with a signed work record from an established platform, like a voyage log from past jobs. The network checks the signature against the platform's public key, then reads the record as a signal of real history: completed jobs, client ratings, dates. Only after three verified records does the agent reach the summit of full earnings. A Sybil with 1,000 fakes must build 1,000 histories first. Faking one profile with 20 paid jobs costs about $2,000 in fees and months of real work, so 1,000 fakes cost over $2 million before earning a cent.
